args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while the docstring and `tests/test_money.py` (per FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- Verified against the test cases:
  - `2.675` → `2.68` (half rounds up because 7 is odd)
  - `2.665` → `2.66` (half rounds to even)

## CI
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
